card.name: Start of new section or drug name
card.fires_on: The first piece of a new section number, heading word or drug name in a drug label, right after a section break or cross-reference. Examples are the digit after a numbered heading's dot, or the first letters of a drug name.

modes.label: Section number digit
modes.description: A digit right after a label section prefix such as 2. or 4. or 5.5, at the start of a numbered heading.

modes.label: Start of heading or drug name
modes.description: The first letters of a heading word or drug name that is split into pieces, such as Ren, Kin, Cin, ri.
